description.value: Sumi Korean Restaurant is a sit-down Korean eatery on Victoria Drive in Vancouver, open six days a week. Located on a busy commercial strip in the Victoria-Fraserview neighbourhood, it offers a convenient stop for cyclists riding the Victoria Drive corridor through the east side of the city. The Korean cuisine focus suggests hearty, carb-rich meals well-suited to refuelling after a long ride.
